source.content: public class VisualEditorShapeDepth { public void compileShape() { Object sink; VisualEditor.DataRow dataRow = new VisualEditor.DataRow('label', 'value'); sink = dataRow.clone(); VisualEditor.DesignTimePageContext context = new VisualEditor.DesignTimePageContext(); String entityName = context.entityName; String pageType = context.pageType; sink = context.clone(); VisualEditor.DynamicPickList pickList = null; sink = pickList.clone(); Object attributeValue = null; String semanticSearchQuery = null; VisualEditor.DataRow defaultValue = pickList.getDefaultValue(); String label = pickList.getLabel(attributeValue); VisualEditor.DynamicPickListRows values = pickList.getValues(); VisualEditor.DynamicPickListRows semanticValues = pickList.getValuesForSemanticSearch(semanticSearchQuery); Boolean valid = pickList.isValid(attributeValue); VisualEditor.DynamicPickListRows rows = new VisualEditor.DynamicPickListRows(); sink = rows.clone(); } }
